title: Extended Mean Field Control Games with Moment Interactions: General Framework and Linear-Quadratic Model
summary: Mean field control games (MFCGs) provide a framework for studying non-cooperative games involving groups of cooperative players in the limit as both the number of players and the number of groups go to infinity.This class of games includes mean field games (MFGs) and mean field control (MFC) problems as special cases, corresponding to purely non-cooperative and purely cooperative settings, respectively.
